read.thesis: Vertiv's Q3 organic sales rose 55% with organic orders up over 100% and FY26 sales guidance raised to $14.7B, but management stopped disclosing orders and is ramping capacity into a Q2 revenue-recognition catch-up.

utilisation.quote: A little bit of that capacity does drive, you know, some of the margin things that we have talked about, but definitely put the capacity in place.

capex.quote: approximately 4.0% of revenue for the full year 2026, focused on global capacity investments
